title: Implement save preset from Elementor widget
description: Implement the protected widget-side flow that saves a manually built Filter Controller configuration as a reusable preset.
objective: Allow an implementer to build filters in Elementor and persist that configuration as a saved preset without leaving the widget workflow.
expected_outputs: Documentation of save behavior and remaining UX gaps
acceptance_criteria: A widget-built filter configuration can be saved as a preset.
The saved preset appears in preset storage.
The save path validates capability and nonce.
Malformed filter rows fail without corrupting existing presets.
The implementation does not require Elementor Pro.
verification: JS syntax check passes for assets/js/eit-editor.js.
Composer validation/autoload passes if PHP files change.
WP-CLI or HTTP smoke saves a preset and verifies stored normalized fields.

budgets.context_budget: editor JS, preset persistence, security handler

risks: Editor UX may need Guilherme QA after the mechanical save path works.
Saving style settings too broadly can make shared presets hard to reuse.
